events.title: First Solo Visit
events.text: {person:child} is arriving for their first sleepover at your place, clutching a small suitcase and big plans.

choices.label: A weekend of spoiling
choices.outcome_text: Pancakes for dinner. Rules suspended. Memories made.

choices.label: Crafts, stories and early bedtimes
choices.outcome_text: The macaroni art hangs in a place of honour.

events.title: The School Play
events.text: {person:child} has a small but, they stress, pivotal role in the school play.

choices.label: Travel in for opening night
choices.outcome_text: Second row. Full heart. A standing ovation of one, many times.

choices.label: Send flowers for the dressing room
choices.outcome_text: My card was read aloud to the whole cast.

choices.label: You'll catch the next one
choices.outcome_text: There is always a next one, they said brightly.

events.title: A Week of Babysitting
events.text: An emergency at home: could you take {person:child} for a full week?

choices.label: Take the whole week
choices.outcome_text: Seven days. I slept for ten afterwards. Worth it.

choices.label: Take a few days, not all
choices.outcome_text: A compromise everyone could live with.

choices.label: You can't manage it this time
choices.outcome_text: Needs must, and it stung anyway.

events.title: The Family Recipe
events.text: {person:child} has decided it is time to learn the famous family recipe. From you. Properly.

choices.label: A full baking day together
choices.outcome_text: Flour everywhere. The secret is apparently 'a feeling'.

choices.label: Write it down on a recipe card
choices.outcome_text: The card is already creased from being carried around.

choices.label: Maybe when they're older
choices.outcome_text: Some recipes wait. Hopefully not too long.

events.title: Holiday Plans
events.text: The family is negotiating where to spend the holidays, and {person:child} has voted loudly for your house.

choices.label: Host everyone at yours
choices.outcome_text: Chaos, crowding, and the good kind of exhaustion.

choices.label: Travel to them instead
choices.outcome_text: I arrived with gifts and left with leftovers.

choices.label: Video calls this year
choices.outcome_text: A pixelated toast across the miles.

events.title: A Work of Art
events.text: {person:child} has presented you with an original portrait. It is... abstract.

choices.label: Frame it properly
choices.outcome_text: It now hangs where every visitor can admire it.

choices.label: Fridge-door gallery placement
choices.outcome_text: Fridge-door gallery placement — the highest honour in my household.

choices.label: Tuck it into a drawer
choices.outcome_text: Some art senses when it has been filed.
